_comment: Hand-authored companion to Hiyori.model3.json, which stays exactly as Cubism exported it.
The Live2D renderer drives idle by calling startRandomMotion over the whole Idle group, so
the only way to hold the character still is to give that group one entry. Idle here is
Hiyori_m03 alone: of the nine stock idle motions it is the only calm one that never opens
the mouth (ParamMouthOpenY stays at 0 for its whole 4.2s), which keeps the mouth free to
mean lip sync and nothing else. TapBody points at the same motion so a tap cannot start a
Everything else - the moc3, textures, physics, pose and the EyeBlink/LipSync groups - is
copied verbatim, so blinking, breathing, physics and lip sync all behave normally.
